subject: Request: SparkBridge onboarding accelerator — combined credits + discount (exec approval)
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@sparkbridge.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@sparkbridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 09:12 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask: onboarding credits + launch discount

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at SparkBridge was really impressed with the latency and the embedding freshness. We’re close to an internal decision but two procurement items are blockers for our initial rollout:

- Can we get an additional 45 days on the trial (current pilot window ends June 15)?
- Can Redwood provide $30k in platform credits to cover model eval and POC usage?
- Are you able to provide a launch discount (we were thinking ~25% for the first 12 months) if we commit to a paid plan and auto-renew?

If we can align on credits + an onboarding extension, we can present to our CFO next week.

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Product, SparkBridge

-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@sparkbridge.com>; Elena Park <elena.park@sparkbridge.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: onboarding credits + launch discount

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and glad the demo landed. We want to make the POC successful and have a clear runway for a production decision.

Proposed pilot sweetener (pending internal approval):
- 90-day extension (pilot end -> 2027-08-15)
- $25,000 in free platform credits applied during the pilot window
- Additional $5,000 evaluation credits available if SparkBridge signs the MOU within 30 days of pilot completion
- 20% launch discount on public list pricing for 12 months if you commit to a 12-month minimal consumption (we can set a $150k minimum ARR threshold)

Before I send this over officially, I need exec sign-off on the combined credits + discount concession. I’ve attached a short onboarding proposal and a SOC2 excerpt our security team can share with procurement.

Attachments:
- SparkBridge_Onboarding_Proposal_v2.pdf (proposal + milestones)
- SOC2-excerpt.pdf (for procurement)

Can you confirm acceptance of the milestones in the proposal? I’ll loop in our sales leadership for approval.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31 08:30 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot ask: onboarding credits + launch discount — request for exec approval

Team — forwarding SparkBridge's ask and my proposed commercial terms below. Quick summary: customer asks for 45-day extension + $30k credits + ~25% launch discount. My proposed compromise: $25k credits upfront + $5k milestone credit, 20% launch discount with 12-mo $150k ARR commitment.

Key considerations:
- Risk: credits + discount reduces short-term revenue; need minimal ARR commitment and MOU/SOW with success milestones.
- Security: procurement will ask for SOC2 and retention details — SOC2 excerpt attached.
- GTM value: SparkBridge is a strategic PMF customer in adtech with strong referral potential.

Pricing impacts (ballpark):
- Estimated net ARR (year 1) under proposal: ~$120k vs. $150k target if no discount — margin hit of ~8–10% in year 1.

Requested approvals:
- Approval to offer $30k total credits (25k now + 5k contingent)
- Approval for 20% launch discount contingent on 12-mo commit and signed MOU
Please reply with: Approve / Approve with change / Decline and proposed alternative.
Forwarded message follows.
-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01 10:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: onboarding credits + launch discount — request for exec approval
Mina — I’m sympathetic to giving a strong onboarding package to close this one. My recommended guardrails:
- Offer the full $30k credits but split: $20k upfront, $10k paid as milestone/top-up tied to the mutual action plan (MAP) completion (integration + one production query rate target).
- Make the 20% launch discount conditional on a 12-month committed consumption floor of $150k ARR and a signed SOW within 30 days of pilot completion.
- Require procurement sign-off on SOC2 (we already shared excerpt) and a short NFR addendum clarifying data handling for PII.
- Add an early-conversion clause: if they convert to paid earlier than pilot end, credits pro-rate against initial invoices.

I’ve attached a draft MOU/DocuSign packet for legal to review.
Attachment: docusign_mou_draft.docx (draft agreement — internal only)
Ben
Director, Sales — Enterprise

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-02 15:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: onboarding credits + launch discount — request for exec approval
Approve with one modification. I agree to the $30k combined credits under Ben's split (20k now / 10k on MAP completion) and the conditional launch discount, but reduce the launch discount to 18% (vs 20%) given margin sensitivity. Conditions to approve:

1) 12-mo minimum consumption floor of $150k ARR (non-negotiable).
2) Signed MOU or SOW within 30 days of pilot completion.
3) Procurement must confirm SOC2 controls; legal to confirm NFR addendum language.

Mina — please send the official offer to SparkBridge with the approved terms and include the MAP milestones and the DocuSign link. I want the revenue ops team to record the concession in the pricing tracker and flag this as a one-time onboarding sweetener.

Marissa Cole
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Note: Aditya verbally concurred (cc) and asked to keep me looped on milestone completion.
-----
internal_note: Approved concession: $30k credits (20k upfront + 10k on MAP completion), 18% launch discount conditional on 12-mo $150k ARR commitment, MOU/SOW within 30 days, SOC2 & NFR addendum required.
